evals.name: governed-cf-and-kyma-topology
evals.description: The account workflow uses governed account setup and collects optional environment details.

files.content:
# Scenario

Create dev and prod subaccounts for the billing application.

# BTP Governance

## Regions
- Allowed: eu10
- Forbidden: none
- Data residency: EU only
- Compliance reason: GDPR
- Preferred region: eu10

## Account Setup
- Global account subdomain: acme-global
- Allowed environments: Cloud Foundry, Kyma

## Naming
- Subaccount pattern: acme-{env}-billing
- Pattern tokens: {env} = environment tier, {space} = space purpose
- Cloud Foundry org pattern: acme-{env}-billing
- Kyma environment pattern: acme-{env}-billing-kyma
- Cloud Foundry space pattern: acme-{env}-{space}
- Environments: dev, prod
- Directory structure: flat
- Max name length: 60

turns.content: Define the account topology for this project.
For dev create both environments: the CF org is acme-dev-billing with spaces acme-dev-dev and acme-dev-qa; the Kyma environment is acme-dev-billing-kyma. For prod create no runtime environment.

assertions.text: Uses acme-global as the global account subdomain without asking for a GUID or another global account identifier
Collects that dev has both Cloud Foundry and Kyma and that prod has no runtime environment
Collects and validates the two named Cloud Foundry spaces only after Cloud Foundry is selected
Writes specs/landscape.md containing the governed global account subdomain and the selected environment and space details

evals.name: missing-global-subdomain-rejects-guid
evals.description: A global account GUID is not accepted when the governance policy has no subdomain.

files.content:
# Scenario

Create one dev subaccount for the billing application.

turns.content: Define the account topology for this project.
Its subdomain is acme-global; create no runtime environment for dev.

assertions.text: Rejects the UUID-shaped global account value and asks for a subdomain
Uses acme-global only after it is supplied as the global account subdomain

evals.name: forbidden-environment-hard-block
evals.description: A selected runtime environment outside governance is blocked before the landscape is written.

files.content:
# Scenario

Create a dev subaccount with a Cloud Foundry environment.

# BTP Governance

## Regions
- Allowed: eu10
- Forbidden: none
- Data residency: unrestricted
- Compliance reason: none
- Preferred region: eu10

## Account Setup
- Global account subdomain: acme-global
- Allowed environments: Kyma

## Naming
- Subaccount pattern: acme-{env}
- Pattern tokens: {env} = environment tier
- Cloud Foundry org pattern: acme-{env}
- Kyma environment pattern: acme-{env}-kyma
- Cloud Foundry space pattern: acme-{env}-{space}
- Environments: dev
- Directory structure: flat
- Max name length: 60

evals.prompt: Define the account topology, including the requested Cloud Foundry environment.

assertions.text: Stops with an Account Setup governance violation because Cloud Foundry is not allowed
Does not write specs/landscape.md before the violation is resolved or Override is explicitly enabled
